```
['create a dummy COCO-style data sample with random keypoints, bboxes, and visibility masks', 'create a dummy batch of model inputs and PoseDataSamples for pose estimation testing', 'load and return a deep copy of the model config from an MMPose config file', 'get the full file path of an MMPose config file from a relative path', 'get the file system path to the root of the MMPose repository directory']
```

